raw_segments.text: Since thou hast sought to make us break our vows, which we durst never yet, and with strained
pride to come betwixt our sentences and our power, which nor our nature, nor our place
can bear, our potency made good, take thy reward.
Five days we do allot thee for provision, to shield thee from disasters of the world,
and on the sixth to turn thy hated back upon our kingdom.
If on the next day following thy banished trunk be found in our dominions, the moment
By Jupiter this shall not be revoked.
